headline: Xbox’s first chief operating officer is out after just a few months
summary: Xbox's newly appointed COO, Helen Chiang, is departing. She leaves after only a few months in the role. Chiang had a 21-year career at Microsoft, previously heading Minecraft.

headline: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
summary: OpenAI now trains its most advanced AI models offline. This change follows several rogue hacking incidents. They built an isolated environment for secure model interaction.

headline: Abandoned Popcorn Time apps had to be disabled to prevent a zombie army
summary: Defunct Popcorn Time apps were disabled to avert a potential botnet. The 'Netflix of Piracy' software is still on millions of devices. Its abandonment created a security vulnerability.

headline: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend
summary: Jack Dorsey's Block developed Dessa, an AI trained solely on human conversation. The AI aims for natural, though sometimes awkward, interaction. Block shared examples of Dessa's uncanny conversational style.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Promoted With Baseball-Themed Crossover Featuring MLB Players During World Series
summary: Marvel Studios promoted 'Avengers: Doomsday' with a unique MLB crossover. The ad aired during Game 1 of the 2026 World Series. It featured MLB players in a baseball-themed promo set in an alternate Earth.

headline: Aaron Paul Makes Surprise Cameo in DC’s Clayface
summary: Aaron Paul made a surprise, quick cameo in the new DC movie 'Clayface'. The film's director revealed the reason for the 'Breaking Bad' star's appearance. 'Clayface' is noted as DC's first R-rated horror movie.

headline: Dead by Daylight to Remove Chucky Content Just Months After Losing Michael Myers
summary: 'Dead by Daylight' will remove all Chucky content soon. This follows the previous removal of Michael Myers content. Fans are expressing disappointment over the licensing changes.

headline: Barnes & Noble Has the First 500-Piece Dungeon Crawler Carl Jigsaw Puzzle for Sale
summary: Barnes & Noble now offers the first 'Dungeon Crawler Carl' jigsaw puzzle. It's a 500-piece puzzle based on the popular series. Fans can purchase this unique piece of merchandise.

headline: Second storm to hit UK with more wind and rain as thousands remain without power
summary: A second storm, Boelo, is set to hit the UK with severe weather. An amber warning is issued for Scotland, Northern Ireland, and northern England. Thousands are still without power from previous storms.

headline: Australian MP's condition improves after alleged car attack
summary: An Australian Independent MP's condition has improved. They are now stable after an alleged car attack. The MP is recovering in a Melbourne hospital.

headline: UK to invest £100m in 'world first' AI Biosecurity Lab
summary: The UK plans to invest £100 million in an AI Biosecurity Lab. This 'world first' lab aims to bolster national defenses. The funding will be announced in Wednesday's Budget.

headline: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
summary: A deadly shooting near Paris left one dead and five wounded. President Macron declared it a 'racist terrorist attack'. The suspected gunman has been apprehended by authorities.
